evals.name: validates-rendered-option-without-settings-edits
evals.expected_output: Reports the rendered output_dir or the private plugin-data fallback, asks whether reports should remain private or use a portable repository location, and never reads or edits settings files or pluginConfigs.
expectations: Reads only the rendered user_config value supplied to the skill
Explains the private plugin-data fallback when output_dir is unset
Does not inspect or edit settings files or pluginConfigs

evals.name: routes-changes-through-claude-configuration
evals.expected_output: Inspects the repository's declared artifact conventions, recommends a portable location, directs the user to Claude Code's plugin configuration prompt, and requires a rerun before claiming the value changed.
expectations: Uses repository evidence before recommending a destination
Routes persistence through Claude Code and verifies on rerun

evals.name: apply-scaffolds-the-tracked-lane-config
evals.expected_output: Reports the effective lane config per layer first, drafts lanes from the repository layout, settles filing_posture, writes only .claude/bug-report.md in the documented format, then re-reads it and confirms it is tracked rather than gitignored.
expectations: Runs the check probes before writing anything
Writes only the tracked .claude/bug-report.md team layer
Uses the key contract in reference/config.md instead of inventing keys
Verifies the written file by re-reading it and by git check-ignore

evals.name: apply-stays-off-user-config-and-gitignore
evals.prompt:
/bug-report:setup apply

Also point output_dir at docs/bug-reports/ and add the ignore line for my personal overlay.
evals.expected_output: Writes the lane config only, routes the output_dir change to Claude Code's plugin configuration prompt, and recommends the recursive .claude ignore line for the .local.md overlay without editing .gitignore.
expectations: Does not write settings files, pluginConfigs, or userConfig
Routes output_dir through Claude Code's native configuration flow
Recommends the overlay gitignore line but leaves the edit to the consumer

evals.name: check-reports-every-cascade-layer
evals.prompt:
/bug-report:setup check

Which lanes does scan actually use here?
evals.expected_output: Reports each cascade layer separately with the layer that supplied each value, names an empty-list opt-out as an opt-out, treats all layers absent as a working state served by the bundled default lanes, and changes nothing.
expectations: Names each layer's presence and version-control verdict separately
Reports the effective lanes and filing_posture with per-value provenance
Treats an absent config as INFO served by the bundled default lanes
